official_faq_quotes: On its own, it doesn't require any license, and can be referenced in public projects.
Tool can be useful for internal testing of Release builds. And it's not necessary to only include it with Debug builds.
But it is still advised to exclude this package on production builds for security and bundle size reasons.
diagnostics_support.assessment: Official support documentation explicitly permits public project references without a separate licence and inclusion in release/internal testing builds. No licence-based removal requirement is established for this INTERNAL baseline. No formal SPDX/source licence grant was found for exact2.2.3, and the repository commit could not be resolved in public source. Do not label it MIT. If public redistribution needs an explicit contractual binary redistribution grant, producer clarification remains open.
ruled_out_assumptions: The MIT licence of AvaloniaUI/Avalonia.Diagnostics applies to the legacy in-process package, not this differently named support package.
The public AvaloniaUI.DeveloperTools repository contains samples/docs, not the private exact92df source; its MIT licence does not establish the licence for shipped DiagnosticsSupport2.2.3.
Generic paid commercial Component redistribution clauses from the Avalonia legal center do not establish applicability to this package.
